name: Maryléne
text: Maryléne, the ticket desk sent this over. The panto matinee moved to the 14th and the refunds are at the counter. Sign the sheet when you collect.

name: Druga
text: Druga, heads up from the grounds team. The pitch is being verti drained monday and the line markings stay off for a week. The gate to the lane must stay shut so the machine can get through.

name: Abdoukarim Merzaee
text: Abdoukarim Merzaee, this came through from the records office. The deeds for the two parcels are back from the registry and the copies are in the vault. The surveyor's report is attached to the file and the boundary plan is being redrawn. Please countersign the transfer page before friday.

name: Alsid Swaroop
text: Alsid Swaroop, the despatch desk passed this on. The pallet of tiles lands friday and needs the forklift booked. Two straps are missing from the kit.

name: Mina
text: Mina, the lettings team sent this over. The hall is booked for the craft fair on the 12th and the kitchen is included in the rate. The caretaker will open up at seven and the tables are already stacked.

name: Svajger
text: Svajger, the fisheries office passed this along. The coarse season reopens on the 16th and the licences run from that date. The otter fence by the lower pond was repaired and the boardwalk planks are being replaced. Day tickets stay at last year's price. The bailiff rota is on the hut wall.

name: Sefë Grimme
text: Sefë Grimme, the print room sent this over. The banner for the fete is ready and the grommets were replaced. Collect it before friday.

name: van Toornburg
text: van Toornburg, this came down from the catering office. The menu for the gala dinner is locked and the allergen sheet went to every table lead. Two vegetarian covers were added and the kitchen needs them confirmed by tuesday.

name: Emily
text: Emily, the housing office forwarded this on. The inspection of the two flats is set for the 21st and access is needed to every room. The damp readings from the last visit are on the file and the contractor has quoted for the extractor. Keys are in the box at the office.

name: Musiari
text: Musiari, the kennels sent this over. The booster day moves to the 9th and the crates are booked out. Bring the vaccination cards.

name: Davey Daveyxl
text: Davey Daveyxl, the survey office passed this along. The levels for the new path are confirmed and the pegs stay in until the digger arrives. The drainage run crosses the old field drain so the team digs with care.

name: Dr. Smith
text: Dr. Smith, the ward clerk sent this over. The bed moves for tuesday are on the board and the discharge letters are ready for signing. Two pharmacy queries are still open and the on call number changed at midnight. The staffing sheet for the weekend is with the matron.

name: Nedjip
text: Nedjip opened the meeting with the parking permits and the new zone map is on the noticeboard. Visitor books go to the office.

name: Hodor
text: Hodor took the minutes. The seed order for the allotment closes on friday and the beds by the wall are being reassigned. Two water butts were repaired and the path edging gets finished sunday.

name: Tchamo Höpp Kavvadias
text: Tchamo Höpp Kavvadias called the meeting to order and the fuel budget was the first item. The minibus runs from the depot and the pooled mileage is nearly gone for the quarter. The electric van trial starts next month and two drivers need the training day. The charging point quote was tabled.

name: de Taddeo
text: de Taddeo ran the session. The bell tower inspection is booked for the 3rd and the rota for the open day is going up. Costs were agreed.

name: Keani
text: Keani opened the meeting and the recycling trial on the estate was reviewed. Uptake is up a third and the glass banks get emptied twice weekly now. Two food waste caddies go to every flat.

name: Raizner
text: Raizner took the notes. The riverbank survey found two eroded spots and the contractor will quote for both. Volunteers cleared the footpath bridge and the council replaced the handrail planks. The fishing platform stays closed until the timber dries. The grant papers are ready and the next walk is in may.

name: Eléonore Fiqirete Kçiku
text: Eléonore Fiqirete Kçiku opened the session. The book fair stall list closed and the takings were banked. The next fair is in june.

name: Ayaovi Gabriely
text: Ayaovi Gabriely ran the meeting. The lunch club numbers are steady and two new helpers joined the rota. The freezer was serviced and the menu cycle rotates next week. Grant forms go in before the end of the month.

name: Aouatef
text: Aouatef opened the meeting with the venue hire review and the rates for the autumn were agreed. The stage extension needs a second quote and the sound desk is being serviced next week. The bar takings from the last event cover the deposit. Poster printing moves to the high street shop.

name: Reinstadler
text: Reinstadler chaired the session. The grit bin on the hill was refilled and a second one is on order. Salt goes first to the school path.

name: Sobral Erfani-Far
text: Sobral Erfani-Far opened the meeting and the defib pads were the first item. Two cabinets went up outside the shops and the code is registered with the ambulance service. The rota for weekly checks is nearly full.

name: Pathmanathan Quartarolo Baronti
text: Pathmanathan Quartarolo Baronti called the meeting to order and the year end accounts were walked through. Two grant claims are still open and the paperwork goes in this month. The boiler fund passed its target and the surplus moves to the roof pot. The auditors visit in april.

name: Sevdush
text: Fwd: boiler room, the pressure was low again so the top up is booked for friday. Sevdush has the spare gauge key. Watch the needle tonight please.

name: Ammerschuber
text: Fwd: cellar chillers, the alarm beeper has been misfiring at night and the contractor is booked for monday. Ammerschuber has kept the fault log since the last visit. Two probes are on order and the readings are being taken by hand until then.

name: Gratz Pittorino
text: Fwd: archive move, the shelving for the strong room arrived damaged and the replacement lands on the 11th. Gratz Pittorino has rescheduled the file transfer to the week after. The index cards are boxed by year and the scanners stay on the mezzanine. Anything on loan is listed at the desk.

name: Luftim Ghadir
text: Fwd: stud books, the farrier moved to wednesday and the two young stock are due their first trim. Luftim Ghadir has the yard diary. Bring the head collars and forms.

name: Laurentiu-Florin
text: Fwd: garden share, the rotas for the water butt and the compost are nearly full and two names are needed for august. Laurentiu-Florin has the shed key and the strimmer fuel is in the crate. Seed swap table goes up on the noticeboard friday.

name: Haftner
text: Fwd: crematorium rota, the new booking system goes live on the 8th and the paper diary closes the day before. Haftner has the training notes and the two admin logins need setting up. The family room heating was fixed and the car park lines are being repainted next week.

name: De Monaco
text: Fwd: tram times, the evening service runs every twelve minutes from monday, last one is 11:40. De Monaco has the new leaflets and the timetables. Pick yours up.

name: Tito Hul
text: Fwd: flood siren test, the monthly check runs on the 5th at eleven and lasts a minute. Tito Hul is on the panel and the log gets signed at the pump house. Residents were told at the meeting.

name: Mamerto
text: Fwd: reservoir levels, the drawdown ends on the 20th and the pumps return to normal running. Mamerto logged the gauge readings through the week and the angling club was told at the hut. The spillway walkway gets its inspection before the level rises and the signs are being reprinted.

name: Dunkelberg
text: Fwd: bin store, the lids were swapped and the fobs go out with the next letters. Dunkelberg has the spare set. Keep the cardboard flat.

name: Hannele Schwen
text: Fwd: pool timetable, the early lane swim moves to 6:30 and the aqua class takes the 9 o'clock slot. Hannele Schwen has the printed cards for the desk and the noticeboard copy is laminated. The hoist check is booked for the 7th.

name: Van Herle
text: Fwd: mill intake, the grain lorry is booked for tuesday morning and the weighbridge certificate runs out on the 30th. Van Herle has the renewal forms and the tester comes the week after. The moisture meter was serviced and the sample bags are restocked. The dockets are filed by load.

name: Fornier
text: Fwd: nature trail, the boardwalk reopens after the repairs and the leaflets are back from the printers. Fornier has the trail count sheet. Sign the log in at the hut.

name: Donny
text: Notes from the shed meeting, the dust extraction pipe is fitted and the saw bench was levelled. Donny is sorting the timber rack and the offcuts box goes by the door. The club fees stay the same.

name: Meneau
text: Notes from the harbour meeting, the pontoon walkway planks are replaced and the electricity posts were tested. Meneau is booking the diver for the mooring chains and the spare fenders are in the store. The fuel berth card reader was swapped last week and the winter rates are agreed.

name: Borac Sbardella Chomich
text: Notes from the shelter meeting, the bedding was counted and two duvets went for repair. Borac Sbardella Chomich has the new rota and the keys. Doors open at eight.

name: Ledor Daubenmeyer
text: Notes from the transport meeting, the school route times are unchanged and the depot swap settles on the 9th. Ledor Daubenmeyer is checking the shelter repairs and the timetable cards for the stop. The pass renewals run online from monday.

name: Martinho
text: Notes from the surgery meeting, the flu clinic dates are set and the booking lines open monday. Martinho is covering the Friday desk while the new receptionist trains. The car park marking is finished and the noticeboard was repainted and the leaflet rack is restocked again.

name: Rüger
text: Notes from the rehearsal meeting, the panto slots are up and the sound checks run from the 5th. Rüger has the doorway list and props are boxed.

name: Enkhtuya Linyi
text: Notes from the cardiology meeting, the clinic list swap is agreed and the echo slots move to wednesday. Enkhtuya Linyi is updating the referral tracker and the discharge summaries go out friday. Two locums start the week after.

name: van Brakel
text: Notes from the tenants meeting, the entry door closer was adjusted and the bike store lock is being replaced. van Brakel is chasing the window repairs and the rooflight quote. The bin store clean happens fortnightly and the noticeboard rules are posted and the garden rota is set.

name: Cilgia
text: Notes from the campus meeting, the bike racks are doubled and the lighting on the path was upgraded. Cilgia has the key list. Tool loans restart monday with a deposit.

name: Levavasseur
text: Notes from the booking office meeting, the group rates are held for the season and the refund window stays at 14 days. Levavasseur is printing the vouchers and the till system update lands tuesday. Staff passes go to the new starters.

name: Franz-Josef Chaowei
text: Notes from the workshop meeting, the bandsaw blade order is in and the dust masks were restocked. Franz-Josef Chaowei is remounting the vice and the clamps are back from the welder. The air line pressure was reset and the spare goggles are in the drawer ready for the course.

name: Iva Kanzoska
text: Notes from the sports meeting, the astro rota is full and the floodlight faults are logged. Iva Kanzoska has the match balls and the pump.

name: Shir
text: Notes from the green meeting, the tree survey is booked and the saplings for the avenue are ordered. Shir is arranging the watering rota and the compost bays are being rebuilt. The bench plaque is on order.
